files.transformation: Copied byte-for-byte as delivered: a 1254 x 1254 RGB WebP. Sixteen tree species in a 4 x 4 grid on a flat magenta (#FF00FF) key background, cells left to right, top to bottom: oak, pine, snow pine, palm, jungle tree, bamboo, dead tree, baobab, acacia, mangrove, olive, cypress, dragon tree, birch, autumn tree, and a generic broadleaf used for every other tree. Bundled with the desktop renderer and processed at run time (chroma key, one-pixel erosion, re-outline, per-cell crop, downscale) into the generated map icon's tree layer.
